scope_note: Engine v2 registry: per-source adapter configs, fixture-tested. Stratum telecom migrated from v1 (all selectors re-verified against 25-08-2026 fixtures). Strata tech_data/media/perimeter appended after the source-completeness audit.

validation_gates.date: must parse against the source's declared date formats; undated rows quarantine unless the source declares undated_ok (document shelves)
validation_gates.url: item links must sit on the source's allowed_domains; anything else quarantines
validation_gates.title: 8-300 chars after whitespace collapse
validation_gates.dedupe: sha1(normalised_title + date)[:10]; repeat sightings on other venues land in the sightings table, never as duplicate items
validation_gates.failure_policy: fetch failure or parse below row_floor = FAILED source; sweep exits non-zero; two consecutive failures = prominent alert

classification.note: No tiers. One deterministic split: routine or substantive. Audited by code/audit_routine.py — ledger and regex must agree exactly.
classification.routine_regex: (?i)assess(es|ed)? (mobile )?network quality|subscription data|performance indicator report|quarterly highlights|panel of auditors|sitting of hon|non-sitting|internship|research associate|vacancy circular|recruitment|seminar|workshop|\bTSTL\b|designat(es|ed)\b.{0,60}\blaborator|empanel|certificate and internship|declaration of holiday|tender|walk[- ]in[- ]interview|consumer (outreach|awareness) program|consumer education workshop|engagement of (young )?professional|CERT-In (Advisory|Vulnerability Note) CI
classification.memo_note: A memo is drafted for a new, non-routine item whose type is in memo_types. Drafts, consultations, releases, notices and designations do not trigger a memo.

sources.name: Notices / Circulars
sources.quirks:
Malformed HTML: never re-opens after row 1, so rows are matched on raw bytes (anchor + following date

). ~430 rows. Practice directions (rare, substantive) appear among routine sitting notices.
sources.lane_reason: Court diary and registry noticeboard: sitting and non-sitting notices, holidays, room reallocations. Useful to a disputes team, but it changes no client obligation. Practice directions remain rare exceptions to lift by hand.

sources.name: PIB releases (all-ministries feed, ministry-filtered)
sources.quirks: PIB offers no per-ministry feed; ministry is confirmed by fetching each new release page once (deterministic substring match). Instrument-announcing releases fold into the instrument they announce at curation.
sources.lane_reason: The press bureau publishes releases ABOUT instruments, never the instrument. A release reporting that the 12-minute ad cap was removed is not the order that removed it.

sources.name: Recent Extraordinary + Weekly panels
sources.quirks: Legally authoritative venue, but the homepage panel carries NO per-item link (the Download column is script-driven) - only a Gazette ID such as CG-DL-E-24082026-275723. Rows are therefore LEADS, not citable instruments, and run in the signals lane: identified by gazette ID, verified by hand against the gazette before any client advice. Full ministry-by-date search is an ASP.NET postback flow, on the roadmap.

sources.name: TRAI sitewide RSS (lag cross-check)
sources.quirks: VERIFIED LAGGING (~6 weeks behind the site). Never a trigger; a catch here that the HTML listings missed is a parser bug and surfaces as a crosscheck WARN.
sources.lane_reason: 10 of 10 entries are consumer outreach, education and awareness events. Announcements, not documents.

sources.name: Gazette Notifications (WP-JSON API)
sources.quirks: Public headless-WP API discovered 25-08-2026 — no headless browser needed (v1 'headless_required' obsolete). Full corpus per call; monotonic wire. KNOWN STALE: newest gazette row is 16-12-2025 while 2026 MeitY gazette instruments exist (DPDP Rules phases, s.79A) — the eGazette + PIB lanes are the real-time net for MeitY; this venue is provenance and eventual-posting.

sources.name: Acts & Policies (WP-JSON API)
sources.quirks: Type string is case-sensitive: 'Act and policies'. Carries DPDP/IT Rules drafts (Mar-2026 draft IT Rules amendments appear here).

sources.name: Orders & Notices (WP-JSON API)
sources.quirks: Mostly internal administration (delegations, work distribution) — routine regex and type rules keep noise down; occasionally carries binding orders.

sources.name: Advisories (CIAD)
sources.quirks: Legacy servlet; rows regex-matched on raw bytes. CIAD numbering sequential per year - gap = missed advisory. Year param must roll over each January.
sources.lane_reason: Third-party vendor patch bulletins (Apple, SAP, Oracle). Issued under s.70B(4)(d) IT Act, which makes them statutory outputs but expressly non-binding. The binding CERT-In material is s.70B(6) Directions and CISG guidelines, both separately tracked.

sources.name: Vulnerability Notes (CIVN)
sources.quirks: Same servlet family; CIVN numbering sequential per year. Year param rolls over each January.
sources.lane_reason: CVE bulletins about Chrome, Mozilla, Cisco and the like. Advisory outputs under s.70B(4)(d); bind no one. By volume the loudest CERT-In feed and by content the least legally meaningful.

sources.name: Security Guidelines (CISG)
sources.quirks: refcode= instead of VLCODE=. CISG numbering sequential per year.

sources.name: s.70B(6) Directions
sources.quirks: Binding directions under IT Act s.70B(6) (e.g. the 2022 six-hour incident-reporting direction). Rare and always substantive.

sources.name: Miscellaneous releases (orders, debarments)

sources.name: Circulars
sources.quirks: Full archive in one page (127 rows). NOT strictly date-sorted - full-table scan every run, never stop-at-first-older. 96/127 hrefs carry raw spaces - URL-encode before download.

sources.name: Gazette-notified standards
sources.quirks: Standards become mandatory on gazette notification (Telecom Act standards framework). CMS-pasted table, no class/id; malformed pre-doctype head. Dates only from the Notification Date column, never filenames. Each row carries TWO links: the standard's own PDF in td[2] and the gazette notification in td[4]. The gazette link is shared by every standard notified together, so the standard's own PDF is the citation.

sources.quirks: tec.gov.in/essential-requirements is DEAD (empty 200 since ~Apr 2026); the MTCTE portal API serves the full dataset (828 elements = 138 records, stride 6). PDFs need GET - HEAD 403s.

sources.name: Advisories

lanes.instruments: Documents that bind a client. Every row must carry its own citation and may trigger a memo.
lanes.signals: Real, useful information that is not itself a binding instrument: announcements, registers, court diaries, security bulletins, mirrors. Shown in its own tab, never in the instruments ledger, never memo-triggering.
